name: Root Fossil
description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling Pokémon.

gifts.note: Choose one fossil. At the top of Mirage Tower in the Route 111 desert. You need the Go-Goggles to cross the desert, and the Mach Bike and Rock Smash to climb. The tower only appears some of the time; leave Route 111 and come back if it isn't there. Taking the Root Fossil makes the tower collapse and the Claw Fossil is lost with it, until you find it in the Desert Underpass after the Hall of Fame.

Postgame: the fossil you left behind. After you enter the Hall of Fame, the tunnel at the back of the Fossil Maniac's house on Route 114 opens into the Desert Underpass. At its far end is the fossil you didn't take from Mirage Tower: the Claw Fossil if you took the Root Fossil, or the Root Fossil if you took the Claw Fossil. Nothing is here if you never took one.
